originalTitle: Wall Street ends higher as Amazon soothes AI jitters
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended higher on Friday, with the Dow adding more than half a percent, the S&P 500 gaining seven-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq climbing one percent. :: Amazon Amazon surged more than 15% after the tech giant posted its biggest quarterly revenue growth in over four years. Its results, along with a similar report from Microsoft this week, alleviated investor concerns about potential overspending on AI data centers. Meanwhile, shares of Apple tumbled more than 7% after a disappointing forecast showed that the iPhone maker was struggling to secure enough components, as the AI-driven data center boom strains global supply chains. Friday marked the end of a bumpy week for stocks that included a Fed policy meeting in which the central bank left rates unchanged - but with three dissenters pushing for a 25 basis point hike. Dean Smith is chief strategist & portfolio manager at FolioBeyond. "I think there was a decent case to be made that a hike is in order. Inflation, we had a slightly softer print on the most recent one, but inflation is now running well above Fed's 2% stated target. It's higher now than it was a year ago and it seems to be reaccelerating. [FLASH] So it was a close call probably, but I think, you know, if I had been on that voting committee, I would have voted for a rate hike as well." :: Archive Other stocks on the move Friday included Monolithic Power Systems, which rose more than 8% after forecasting third-quarter revenue above estimates. But shares of GoDaddy slid nearly 17% after the domain registrar narrowed its annual revenue forecast.

chineseTitle: 亚马逊缓解 AI 恐慌，华尔街收高
chineseSummary: 故事：华尔街周五收高，道琼斯指数上涨超过半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数上涨十分之七，纳斯达克指数上涨百分之一。 :: 亚马逊 科技巨头亚马逊公布四年多以来最大季度收入增长，股价飙升逾 15%。其结果以及微软本周发布的类似报告缓解了投资者对人工智能数据中心潜在超支的担忧。与此同时，由于人工智能驱动的数据中心繁荣给全球供应链带来压力，苹果公司的股价下跌了 7% 以上，此前令人失望的预测显示，这家 iPhone 制造商正在努力获得足够的零部件。周五标志着​​股市动荡一周的结束，其中包括美联储政策会议，美联储维持利率不变，但三名持不同意见者主张加息 25 个基点。 Dean Smith 是 FolioBeyond 的首席策略师兼投资组合经理。 “我认为有充分的理由表明加息是合理的。通胀方面，我们最近的通胀率略显疲软，但通胀现在远高于美联储2%的既定目标。现在的通胀率比一年前更高，而且似乎正在重新加速。[快闪]所以这可能是一次千钧一发的机会，但我想，你知道，如果我是那个投票委员会的成员，我也会投票支持加息。” :: Archive 周五上涨的其他股票包括 Monolithic Power Systems，该公司在预测第三季度收入高于预期后上涨超过 8%。但在域名注册商缩小年度收入预期后，GoDaddy 股价下跌近 17%。
